title: The King of Fighters 2002
note: Neo Geo fighting game: health, timer, scores, the teams and their fighters beaten, the fighter on screen with the 41 names, the state of the fight, the power gauges and stocks (1.33, from the RetroAchievements code notes and Seb's captures). The fighting order of a team is not read (no address known), the team line waits for it.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over

bios_request.note: BIOS_USER_REQUEST: 2 demo, 3 title screen (asked by the BIOS when a coin goes in on an MVS)

bios_timer.note: BIOS_COMPULSION_TIMER: seconds left on the title screen before the game starts by itself

bios_mvs.note: BIOS_MVS_FLAG: 0 home console (AES, no coins), otherwise arcade (MVS)

health.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0x66; a K.O. takes its 16-bit word below zero, its high byte at 0xFF (RetroAchievements code notes, lose = ff), which read as a full bar and hid every K.O. (Seb, 1.31): from 0x80 it reads empty; 0 is a fighter still standing, at his lowest (RetroAchievements code notes, The King of Fighters '98 0x8438: 0x0000 = lowest possible health while alive, underflows when dead), read as 1 since 1.31.1, it read as a K.O. in the middle of a fight (Seb)

health_p2.note: player 2 health in %, full = 0x66; a K.O. takes its 16-bit word below zero, its high byte at 0xFF (RetroAchievements code notes, lose = ff), which read as a full bar and hid every K.O. (Seb, 1.31): from 0x80 it reads empty; 0 is a fighter still standing, at his lowest (RetroAchievements code notes, The King of Fighters '98 0x8438: 0x0000 = lowest possible health while alive, underflows when dead), read as 1 since 1.31.1, it read as a K.O. in the middle of a fight (Seb)

score.note: player 1 score, same place as in KOF 98 (identical player record), to be confirmed in game

score_p2.note: player 2 score, same place as in KOF 98 (identical player record), to be confirmed in game

beat.note: VS match, player 1 win streak (BEAT BY at the top of the screen), to find with learn.bat (beat=...)

beat_p2.note: VS match, player 2 win streak (BEAT BY at the top of the screen), to find with learn.bat (beat2=...)

backdrop.note: backdrop of the fight (cheat database "Select Backdrop"): 0 Japan, 1 Korea, 2 China, 3 Holland, 4 Cambodia, 5 Mexico, 6 Italy, 7 Rugal, 8 NESTS. Picks the HD theme in "hd": "stages"

_screen.note: the screen the game shows (RetroAchievements code notes, 0x858b Game - Screen ID? [8 bits], 0x23 = Select Character 1, 0x2f = Select Character 2); its select screens give VS and no event of a fight (1.31.1, K.O. audit), to confirm in game

_p1_lost.note: P1, fighters already beaten (RetroAchievements 0xa7e4 'P2 rounds won, actually P1 rounds lost'); it does not count the picks on the select screens, unlike '98 (Seb's capture of 18:02)

_p1_ch0.note: P1, team character A (RA 0xa7e7 slot 1, 0xFF on the select screen); RetroAchievements code notes of The King of Fighters 2002, the byte next to the note's address as for its timer and screen (Seb's capture of 2026-11-04)

_p1_cur.note: P1, the fighter on screen (RA 0x8170 Current Character, the same in 2000 and 2001)

_p2_lost.note: P2, fighters already beaten (RA 0xa80a, 'P1 rounds won, actually P2 rounds lost, counts both on draw or time out')

_p2_cur.note: P2, the fighter on screen (RA 0x8370 Current Character)

_in_p1.note: BIOS_P1CURRENT: the stick and buttons of player 1 (bit 0 up, 1 down, 2 left, 3 right, 4 A, 5 B, 6 C, 7 D), read at every frame, for the captures and the moves to come (1.33)

_in_p2.note: BIOS_P2CURRENT: the stick and buttons of player 2, same bits

_fight_state.note: the state of the fight, at '98's place (2001's RetroAchievements notes, Match State bitflags): 0 before a round (its intro) and between the screens, 2 once GO is given (bit 1, the fight runs), 1 at a K.O. (round finished); no READY state here (Seb's capture of 2026-11-04 18:02). FIGHT ! comes with 2, ROUND n with 0 after 1, as in '98

power.note: P1 power gauge in %, at '98's place, full at 0x40 then a stock (Seb's capture of 18:02: 61 then 0 with a stock)

power_level.note: P1 stocks (RetroAchievements 0x82e2 Gauge Level, at '98's place), 3 at most: POWER MAX

select.note: 1 on the character select and the order select (RA 0x858b Screen ID: 0x23 Select Character 1, 0x2f Select Character 2; Seb's capture shows 0x23 then 0xDA 'Order Select/Fighting' for the rest of the game, so the order screen may not be told, to confirm)

round.note: the round of the match, one more at each fighter beaten (1.33)

hd.note: HD screen theme for each backdrop value (index = value), see README, HD themes

capture_renames.note: values renamed since Seb's captures of 2026-11-04 (probes confirmed), for tools/replay_capture.py
